purpose: Replicate the V8 final later-selection endpoint with MiMo using MiMo-sourced V7 selections and their resulting learned-recommender shelves.
studyRole: Prespecified second-provider replication of the final link in the one-step recommendation-order to model-selection to recommender-exposure to later-model-selection chain.
claimBoundary: The study concerns MiMo outputs over pseudonymous derived features in a research storefront. It does not establish human behavior, purchases, production-retailer effects, long-run amplification, or welfare consequences.

sampling.frame: All 460 frozen tasks crossed with SASRec and GRU4Rec; no conditioning on current-choice or next-slate divergence.
sampling.dependence: Resample tasks within category, retaining both recommender families in each task cluster.

decisionInstrument.controlSelection: Include a task-model unit when the first 64 bits of sha256(category/taskId/modelFamily/downstream-control), interpreted as an integer, are divisible by four.
decisionInstrument.controlState: Repeat the immediate-a next-task state byte-for-byte under all four condition labels; cache scopes remain distinct.
decisionInstrument.responseContract: MiMo receives the exact select-or-abandon JSON template in addition to provider-native structured-output mode.
decisionInstrument.nextTaskProxy: The held-out chronological next item defines a private token-overlap and price-similarity intent proxy. Titles, tokens, raw item IDs, and the held-out item are never sent.
decisionInstrument.candidateOrder: Use the actual next slate emitted after each MiMo V7 selected action was written back; do not send an explicit platform-rank field.
decisionInstrument.hardConstraint: A selectable candidate must share at least one non-stopword title token with the held-out next item; abandon is valid if none do.

estimand.name: categorical energy distance
estimand.formula: 2 * mean(immediate != held over four cross-arm pairs) - 1[immediate A != immediate B] - 1[held A != held B]
estimand.primary: MiMo downstream categorical action distance over all 920 primary units.
estimand.negativeControl: MiMo categorical distance in the independently selected byte-identical control subset.

confirmatoryGate.prerequisite: The frozen feedback-exposure gate is true before calls begin.
confirmatoryGate.primary: MiMo downstream-action lower 95% bound is above zero.
confirmatoryGate.reliability: Primary and control protocol failure rates are each below 0.05.
confirmatoryGate.recurrence: SASRec and GRU4Rec primary point estimates are both above zero.
confirmatoryGate.decision: All five requirements must pass to replicate the final link in MiMo.
